description: Turn-by-turn guidance for one drive of a finished coverage plan (`submit_optimise_job` with `kind: "coverage"`, read with `get_job`), in one call. Give `job_id` (the coverage job, the caller's own and `succeeded`), `chunk_id` (the outing's `id` in `result.chunks`, from 1) and `drive`: "outing" (default, the outing itself), "transfer" (the drive into that outing from the previous one's end, or from where the car is; `chunk_loops` plans) or "transfer_to_start" (the plan's drive back to its start; no `chunk_id`). The gateway walks every piece of that drive's `trace_route_parts` on the engine's exact edge walk and answers one trip: `legs` has one entry per piece in driving order, each with its maneuvers, plus the whole drive's `distance_m`, `duration_s` and `geometry_polyline6`. Pieces join mid-street wherever the plan allowed: a leg's closing arrival and the next leg's opening departure at the same point mean carry straight on, not stop. Exact or nothing: it never falls back to map matching (which drops streets driven in and straight back out), so a piece the engine refuses is an error naming that piece and the engine's own words. Metered by the gateway as one call at the size of a /trace_route of the drive (one call per started block of shape points, never fewer than the pieces). A refused piece keeps those quota units (the engine did the work) but takes no prepaid credit or x402 payment; a request refused before walking (unknown or unfinished job, no such outing) is not billed. Premium for a truck plan. Requires the MapMap gateway.

CoverageGuidanceDrive.description: Which drive of a coverage plan `coverage_guidance` guides.

oneOf.description:
The drive into the outing from the previous outing's end, or for
the first outing from where the car is (`start.snap: exact`):
`chunks[].transfer_from_previous`, `chunk_loops` plans.

The plan's drive from the last outing back to `start`
(`transfer_to_start`, `chunk_loops` with `return_to_start`). Takes
no `chunk_id`.

chunk_id.description:
The outing's `id` in the job's `result.chunks` (from 1). Required
unless `drive` is `transfer_to_start`.

drive.description:
`outing` (the default), `transfer` (the drive into that outing) or
`transfer_to_start` (the plan's drive back to its start).

job_id.description:
The coverage job's id, as `submit_optimise_job` (`kind: "coverage"`)
returned it. The job must be this key's own (or another key of the
same account) and `succeeded`.

name: coverage_guidance

CoverageGuidanceLeg.description: One piece of a guided drive: the engine's own answer for it.

duration_s.description: The piece's estimated driving time, seconds.

maneuvers.description:
Its turn-by-turn maneuvers. A piece that ends mid-street closes
with an arrival and the next opens with a departure at the same
point: there the driver simply carries straight on.

piece.description: The piece's number, from 1, in driving order.

ManeuverOut.description: One turn-by-turn instruction of a computed route.

country.description:
ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of the road the manoeuvre starts on, e.g.
`"GB"`. This and the road fields below come from the MapMap gateway's
road walk: present when the route was computed through the gateway
(GATEWAY_URL + GATEWAY_API_KEY) and the map knows the road, absent
otherwise. Never inferred.

distance_m.description: Length of the maneuver in metres.

driving_side.description:
The side of the road traffic keeps to there, `"left"` or `"right"`;
present only when the road's country is known.

duration_s.description: Estimated duration of the maneuver in seconds.

instruction.description: Written instruction, e.g. "Turn right onto Main Street".

landmark_instruction.description:
The same manoeuvre anchored to a recognisable place, e.g. "Turn
right just after the Shell garage", present only when the request
set `landmarks: true` and a place near the junction cleared the
salience bar. Prefer reading this aloud when it is there: it is how
a passenger would give the direction. `instruction` is always the
engine's own and is never replaced.

ref.description:
Route numbers of that road (`"; "` separated, e.g. `"A27"` or
`"I 5; US 101"`); absent when it carries none, never read from a
street name.

road_class.description:
Engine road class of that road (`motorway`, `trunk`, `primary`,
`secondary`, `tertiary`, `unclassified`, `residential`,
`service_other`).

speed_limit_posted.description:
The posted limit as the sign shows it, in the road's own unit:
`{"type":"known","value":30,"unit":"mph"}` (plus `"national":true`
for a national limit), `{"type":"unlimited"}` or `{"type":"unknown"}`.
Read from the road the manoeuvre mostly travels along.

speed_limit_sign.description:
The speed-limit sign family there: `"vienna"` (roundel) or
`"mutcd"` (US and Canadian rectangle).

speed_limit_unit.description:
The unit speed limits are posted in on that road, `"mph"` or
`"km/h"`, from its country (never from the request's units).

subdivision.description:
ISO 3166-2 subdivision of that road where the map carries one, e.g.
`"GB-ENG"` or `"US-CA"`.

chunk_id.description: The outing's `id`, when one was named.

duration_s.description: The whole drive's estimated driving time, seconds.

geometry_polyline6.description:
The whole drive's geometry as the engine walked it, polyline6,
legs joined at their shared points.

legs.description: One leg per piece, in driving order, each with its maneuvers.
